scientific_scope: Discredited historical doctrine. Do not infer intellect,character,ability,illness,criminality or protected traits from skull shape. Historical names are not modern brain anatomy or diagnoses.

feasibility.high_roi_core: A single-edition educational organ-label/terminology lookup keyed to an inspected original schematic; source-attributed historical claims and critical context,not assessment of a head.
feasibility.initial_candidate: Spurzheim1833 Vol1 original numbered plate and corresponding labels,if complete and legible; preserve allegedly35 faculties as an inventory/curator lead until counted in the original.
feasibility.input: User-selected historical schematic/printed label ID or generic teaching template; no diagnostic scans,photos or human skull measurements.
feasibility.output: JSON/Markdown historical reference with original printed/plate locators,versioned label mappings,uncertainty and source differences; no strength/ability scores.
feasibility.avoid: A3D pipeline or shape-to-faculty classifier is unnecessary for the first educational reference release.
